title: SG-1.3.1 defaultArtPaths targets game/public/assets
summary: generateArt resolves assets and the app manifest under game/public/assets
description: Context: defaultArtPaths in game/frontend/scripts/generateArt.ts resolves assetsRoot to <scriptDir>/../public/assets (game/frontend/public/assets), but the app manifest imported by src/runtime/content.ts lives at game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json. Desired: assetsRoot becomes <scriptDir>/../../public/assets and manifestPath sits under it at worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json, with the test updated. Why: art:generate must write PNGs and manifest entries where the app reads them.
acceptance_criteria: Given scriptDir /repo/game/frontend/scripts, when defaultArtPaths is called, then assetsRoot is /repo/game/public/assets
Given the same scriptDir, then manifestPath is /repo/game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json
technical_constraints: One shared palette of at most 48 colours; art is generated deterministically in-repo, no downloaded art
Unit tests with all dependencies mocked
